question: Should OpenClaw support `gateway.suspend.prepare`, `gateway.suspend.status`, and `gateway.suspend.resume` with these reversible process-wide admission semantics as a public Gateway lifecycle contract?
rationale: The API deliberately changes service availability and creates a durable operator-facing compatibility commitment; correctness review cannot decide that product boundary.

options.title: Adopt after exact-head proof
options.body: Accept the public contract once both authenticated transports and all recovery states are demonstrated on the reviewed SHA.

options.title: Keep the primitives internal
options.body: Retain generic admission and coordinator code while deferring public RPC exposure to a separately approved API design.

options.title: Defer cooperative suspension
options.body: Pause the branch until host snapshot lifecycle support is an explicit product priority.

recommendation.title: Adopt after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the public contract once both authenticated transports and all recovery states are demonstrated on the reviewed SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects Peter to the affected safe-restart, Gateway lifecycle, and protocol surfaces.
